blocks.text: ABUJA, Nigeria — A boat carrying people to a funeral has capsized in southern Nigeria, killing at least 24 people, emergency services said on Saturday. The boat was taking passengers from one community to another for a burial ceremony when it sank on Friday in Bayelsa State in the country’s South South region, Nigeria’s National Emergency Management Agency spokesman Manzo Ezeki said in a statement.
